CommunityPage
A community's page: banner, identity, actions, tabs, and the feed as post cards (Parts/Posts/PostCard). A post starts only here, so Post sits on this page and nowhere in the shell.
Header actions: a visitor sees Follow and Join. Once they follow, Join takes the full width. Once they are a member, the one button is Post. Joining also follows. An account that cannot join sees Follow only. There is no request to join: a community is open or gated, and the gate is shown in the sheet Join opens (Parts/Verification/VerifySheet).
Your profile here: a member sees their profile for this community as a round button in the banner, beside More. With one profile it opens that profile, where a handle can be chosen. With several it opens the list to switch (Parts/Identity/YourProfiles). A visitor has no profile here and sees no button.
More is always at the top right: Share, plus Unfollow, Leave, and Manage for an owner. A dropdown on desktop, a sheet on phone.
Tabs: on desktop they sit at the left at their own width; on phone they share the width. About is a card beside the feed on desktop and a third tab on phone.
A member with no handle and no name shows as "User" and six characters, as the second post does.
To draw: the sort control, loading, empty and error.
